critique: The render convincingly produces the core Streaklet Twist look: many thin lime-green line streaks sweep through a tight curled/twisted formation against clean black, with good density and depth layering. However, frames 1 and 4 are visually identical, so the result has no discernible motion. A preset named Streaklet Twist should read as an actively rotating/twisting streak system rather than a static line sculpture.

suggestions.why: Animate World Rotation Y so the twisted streak structure visibly rotates between rendered frames while retaining the existing composition and line design.
